title: COMPONENT_NAME.md
description: Schema for the structured representation of a COMPONENT_NAME.md file. The on-disk format is Markdown; this schema is for tooling that parses it into structured form.

component.description: The component's name as it appears in code.

location.description: File path(s) relative to repo root. Auto-generated.

verified_against.description: The git commit at which the authored fields were last verified accurate.

depends_on.description: Components this component calls or imports. Auto-generated.

used_by.description: Components that call or import this component. Auto-generated.

change_impact.description: Authored. What kinds of changes affect which downstream components, and how.

targeted_verification.description: Authored. Specific tests or checks to run after modifying this component.

public_interface.description: Optional. Explicit list of exported symbols considered stable.

stability.description: Optional. Stability level of the component.

notes.description: Optional. Free-form authored context. Use sparingly.
